findings.evidence: Repository-wide rg finds only its definition, bijectivity theorem, and use in MulEquiv.ofBijective; the computation theorem at line 173 concerns only specialLinearEquivFrobeniusFixedPoints.

findings.issue: The public specialLinearFrobeniusEmbedding has no rule identifying its underlying matrix, so consumers cannot recover its advertised coefficient action without unfolding.

findings.evidence: Both declarations remove a new equivalence application under coercion and have no simp attribute; the analogous coe_fixedSubgroupCongr_apply and coe_fixedSubgroupCongr_symm_apply in FixedSubgroup.lean:156–166 are @[simp].

summary: The public coefficient embedding lacks a characteristic computation lemma, and the equivalences’ computation rules lack simp annotations.
